runtimeVideoPatch.purpose: Use the phone's 320×480 32-bit framebuffer instead of 640×480 in VBE mode 0x142.

guest.conversion: qemu-img convert -f vmdk -O raw nova-cust-image-sdk1457.vmdk public/images/webos.img
guest.kernelExtraction: dd if=public/images/webos.img of=/tmp/webos-rootfs.img bs=512 skip=63; debugfs -R 'dump /boot/bzImage-2.6.26 public/images/bzImage' /tmp/webos-rootfs.img

runtimePointerPatch.purpose: Read the v86 PS/2 mouse device; the original SDK expects two additional VirtualBox input devices. The patch is applied only to the in-memory disk overlay.

pointer.interface: VirtualBox VMMDev 1.4, matching the SDK's Guest Additions 2.1.4
pointer.input: Absolute VMMDev coordinates with PS/2 button and synchronization events
pointer.gestures: One primary pointer: mouse, pen, or touch
